spec_match.rationale: The six steps mirror the spec/explainer lifecycle (preconditions order from sub_apps.cc, unified single prompt, 20-per-prompt/50-total quotas, record-shaped list(), NotFoundError on remove) and the scope checker implements the exact mutual-prefix ConstraintError rule.

interactive.rationale: Prev/Next stepping, a batch-size input that changes prompt/quota outcomes including the honest nothing-installed path for >20, a live-updating shelf illustration, an editable scope-overlap checker, and a genuine window.subApps.list() attempt fired on every transition.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises a stepped lifecycle with live list() attempts and a scope checker; both are present and real.

edge_cases.rationale: Over-quota batches now show the batch-rejected/nothing-installed state at every later step (fixed during this build after CDP review caught 20 icons appearing for a rejected batch of 25), and the scope checker covers both prefix directions plus the parent-prefix case.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry plus the spec's quota-limits and permissions-policy anchors.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's quota and response-shape contracts are recorded as manual IWA-only assertions; the exposure scripts this page's real list() attempt depends on run live.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP drive: stepped 1→4, set batch=25 and confirmed the corrected rejected-batch messaging, counted shelf figures, triggered the scope-overlap ConstraintError verdict, and verified the real list() attempt printed the genuine TypeError; zero console errors, 0px overflow in both viewport classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: subapps-lifecycle-real-list fires only on genuine resolution; the hosted-tab branch asserts subapps-lifecycle-fallback-honest against the real TypeError, keeping fallback separate from pass.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; the current-step row is bg-ivory-on-text-black (AA); the shelf illustration is explicitly captioned as not a real install so no faked state ships.

accessibility.rationale: Steps use aria-current, the shelf has role=img with a caption, all state changes are announced through an aria-live polite output, and controls are native and labelled — but the accessibility tree was not inspected (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), so the role=img grouping on the illustrative shelf is unaudited.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800; controls and the batch input go full-width on mobile; step rows and stage panels wrap cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Audit the shelf illustration's accessibility-tree exposure
openQuestions.detail: The shelf uses role="img" with an aria-labelledby caption to collapse decorative figures into one announced node. Inspect the actual accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp (or a screen reader) to confirm the figures' text is not double-announced and the caption reads sensibly.

openQuestions.title: Drive the walkthrough from real state inside an IWA
openQuestions.detail: Inside an installed IWA the page could seed the shelf and quota meter from the genuine list() record instead of the illustration. The real-attempt panel already distinguishes the cases; wiring resolved data into the visualization is the natural upgrade.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates aria-live button action result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-current for position-in-set, keep decorative visuals out of the accessible flow, and announce state changes via a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: aria-current="step" on the active step, role=img + caption on the illustrative shelf, aria-live polite output announcing every step change and install count.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrapping flex controls and single-column collapse on narrow viewports; never rely on fixed widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls flex-wrap and become full-width under 640px including the number input; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Interactive six-step lifecycle anchored to reality by a genuine list() attempt per transition and an honest rejected-batch path for over-quota installs (a faked-success inconsistency was caught and fixed during this build). CDP-verified in headless Chromium on both viewport classes with all controls driven and zero console errors; accessibility-tree inspection remains open pending a chrome-devtools-mcp environment.
